notes.title: New Miniatures Capsule Art 👁️✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616006/cfa5c6056a40e4c36a71ebee3f64fcc2485a4805.png[/img]

We wanted to highlight the visuals and story elements that make our game special. So instead of focusing on objects, the artist Balazs created something a bit more mysterious and character focused. notes.title: 💛 Miniatures 25% off 💛
notes.content:
It's Miniatures first seasonal sale! And we're celebrating it with 25% off 💛

For those of you who are curious about this strange little game, here's a visual explanation of what the game is: [previewyoutube=3Tma3zvYOoM;full][/previewyoutube]
And a written one:

Play four standalone point-and-click stories, each with a different main character. Follow four children and try to make sense of their experience of an adult world. 

One character is assembling furniture with his family and as the family's disfunction becomes more apparent, [i]something[/i] starts creeping in 🪛 Another character is searching for her missing mother in a desolate archipelago and she needs to decide what to make of what she finds 🦋 A third character is playing pretend with the inhabitants of a sand castle and is unaware of the fragility of life 🐚 The fourth is left home alone and the forced isolation upends his reality 🦎

How will you interpret these stories?

We also want to take the opportunity to wish you happy holidays 💛 See you next year!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2428840/Miniatures/

~ The Others

notes.title: We present to you: Other Tales' Tales! 🦎🪛🐚🦋 /🕰️
notes.content:
Our first developer bundle! We're now a company that has made more than one game! It's been five years since the release of Tick Tock: A Tale for Two and we're still in awe about the reception you've given our very first game... Now Miniatures is out too! And we've put these two story-driven games in a discounted bundle for you: 

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/46610/Other_Tales_Tales/

Other Tales' Tales consists of our strange worlds Miniatures and Tick Tock: A Tale for Two. The first is a single-player, short story collection told through the lense of children making sense of an adult world. The second is a two-player, co-op game where your communication skills are put to the test. They are both atmospheric, hand-drawn, point-and-click games with a touch of magic. 

We hope you find something to love in both!

~ The Others

notes.title: 🎉💛 Miniatures is out! 🎉💛
notes.content:
We can’t believe it... It’s been five years since the release of our first game, and four years since we started working on Miniatures. It’s fun to look back on the stories that didn’t make the cut, the prototypes that didn’t stick with us or didn’t fit in with the rest. Because now the final four stories are finished, wrapped, and put in a box. Ready for you to open!🦎🪛🐚🦋

https://youtu.be/3Tma3zvYOoM

Thanks to everyone for your continued support and we hope you love this strange little collection that is Miniatures as much as we do! To celebrate the release Miniatures is 10% off!

~ The Others

notes.title: Miniatures release date set - the 14th of November!
notes.content:
We can finally let you know that Miniatures will be out on Steam (PC, Mac, and Steam Deck), iOS, and Nintendo Switch on the 14th of November 💛

For those who haven't heard about the game before, Miniatures is a short story collection about how children experience the world. Play through four memories where reality interlaces with the magical, add a splash of eeriness and you're introduced to the world of Miniatures. 

You'll be able to play all four stories: Familiar, The Paludarium, The Last Sand Castle, and The House of the Moon 🪛🦎🐚🦋

notes.title: Introducing the fourth game of Miniatures 🪛🦎🐚🦋
notes.content:
We are excited to reveal the fourth and final story of Miniatures: The House of the Moon 🦋

The House of the Moon is an adventure where the child Alma searches for her missing mother. 

[previewyoutube=JYY5MTsuwYw;full][/previewyoutube]
Alma travels across islands, trying to make sense of her mother's disappearance. Did she leave willingly? Was she lured away? Or something else entirely?

The four stories can be played in any order and are standalone segments. Together they show the world through the eyes of children, where strange things hide in long forgotten memories. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2428840/Miniatures/

~ The Others

notes.title: Introducing the third game of Miniatures 🪛🦎🐚🦋
notes.content:
We are excited to reveal the third story of Miniatures: The Last Sand Castle 🐚

[previewyoutube=kPjJp22qGOc;full][/previewyoutube]

It is a lighthearted and instrumental point-and-click adventure populated with little creatures. Help them out before it’s too late!

This game-concept was quite fittingly created when the team went on a summer house trip by the coast in Denmark. Here we were inspired by the rocks, sand and driftwood to create a whole assembly of whimsical characters. 

We hope you will enjoy this mini-trailer for the third game 💛

~ The Others

notes.content:

Thanks to A MAZE. for a wonderful event and thanks to Wings for this award 🦋

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616006/d31af53b3d4fce683b809b2d54317aa006bffcf8.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616006/d5903b02ecb59510338df3bd195f30ff395593c2.jpg[/img][/url]

This laudation from Astrid at Wings made us smile: 
"This game invites the player to explore a small and intimate world through simple tasks and chores. What begins as play and wonder of a child soon becomes dark and filled with secrets. What the game teaches you of simple, joyful puzzles suddenly becomes actions of broken trust and arguments. With its hand-drawn art, well-designed audio, and occasional laughter of a child the game creates its own world where the player soon finds themselves caring for the characters whose faces and words they have not yet heard."

Thanks for seeing the details and small wonders of Miniatures 💛

~ The Others

notes.title: Assembling furniture is anything but "wholesome" in this fantastic Steam Next Fest demo
notes.content:
You know those wee indie games about opening boxes and organising items and assembling furniture and they're all very cute and colourful and fun and "wholesome"? Miniatures is not one of those games. Oh certainly you will open boxes and organise items and assemble furniture in its Steam Next Fest demo, but it's not cute or colourful or wholesome. Miniatures is more of a psychological horror game, laden with tension and uncertainty. For such a short demo, it built a great mood, and I'm excited for the full game to come later this year.

Read more
